caption_link.limitation: The source provides matching numeric IDs only. It does not provide an original post URL, date, media link, or an explicit asset-to-caption key.

inspection.evidence_scope: Source-bound start, material-intermediate, and near-complete frames were extracted from the original local GIF and visually inspected; metadata came from that same source file.

motion_sampling.method: Three source-bound frame samples extracted from the original local GIF for review; no derivative was added to the corpus.
motion_sampling.limitation: Three sampled frames establish the observed state change, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

visual_anatomy.title: A broad promise for “14 PROVEN LinkedIn Post Ideas” combines a lightweight headline with one lavender highlighted word-object.
visual_anatomy.layout: A left-to-right spectrum arrow organizes 14 prompt cards into personal, reflective, and professional territories linked by curved paths.
visual_anatomy.reading_order: Title → the large spectrum label → individual prompt cards within each territory → small moving markers / connectors.
visual_anatomy.typography: Large headline, rough highlighted word, bold card labels, and editable-looking sentence starters in smaller sans type.
visual_anatomy.colour: Lavender introduces personal prompts, blue handles reflective prompts, and aqua handles professional prompts.
visual_anatomy.surface: White background, raised pale cards, curved dark connectors, a large two-tone arrow, and light drop shadows.
visual_anatomy.modules: Fourteen prompt cards arranged as five personal, four reflective, and five professional ideas.
visual_anatomy.density: High but modular: a reader can save the whole list or extract one usable prompt independently.

motion.observed_state_change: Sampled frames show small colored markers travelling through the spectrum and along card connectors while the full prompt board remains visible.
motion.motion_job: Direct attention along an existing categorical route; the movement does not replace the static map.
motion.limitation: Three sampled frames establish the observed state change, not a frame-by-frame reconstruction of timing or platform playback.

transferable_mechanism.reader_job: Browse a broad set of prompt types without reading them as an arbitrary checklist.
transferable_mechanism.mechanism: Make the organizing continuum explicit, then place modular examples along it so a reader can locate themselves and choose one entry point.
transferable_mechanism.use_condition: Use only when a meaningful continuum exists; otherwise use a clearer taxonomy or table.

anti_copy_boundary: Do not reuse the 14-item prompt bank, personal-to-professional spectrum, source title/claim, individual cards, colors, connectors, or motion markers.

claim_boundary.note: “Proven” is a visible source assertion. The corpus does not include evidence sufficient to reuse that claim.
